# DepthOfFieldEffect

- Inherits [`PostEffect`](posteffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect")`

Blurs the picture by distance, as a camera lens does: a band of the world is in focus, and what is nearer or farther is blurred. The sky counts as infinitely far away.

When several apply, the first enabled one is used: the children of `Lighting` are considered first, then the camera's. It is not drawn on a machine whose graphics settings turn depth of field off.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FarIntensity` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How much what is farther than the sharp band is blurred, from 0 (not at all) to 1. |
| `FocusDistance` | `number` | `25` | read/write | The distance from the camera that is sharpest, in meters. |
| `InFocusRadius` | `number` | `10` | read/write | The distance on either side of `FocusDistance` that stays fully sharp, in meters. The blur begins beyond it. |
| `NearIntensity` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How much what is nearer than the sharp band is blurred, from 0 (not at all) to 1. |
